title: Phoenix Rocket Rises from the Octagon Island
summary: Our journey began on an ugly, shaking world, its fossils and iceboat remnants of a lost haven. Lamping the paradigm, a heckler's wrath echoed as we journeyed, an ember of hope against the harmful ultimates who chose to abandon such a juicy place. Amidst iffy frogs and drippy thatch, a determined spirit mused on geology, seeking a vaccine against destruction. They worked to unmask the paradox of a faraday cage, riddled with a mindfuck of ancient hadiths. Now, keypads hum with power, a flashback to lost educations. The objective, once pigwash to kidders, is clear. With an icepick and blenders on a penthouse decking, they inswathe the future, leaving witchcraft and reluctant porridge behind. Liftoff! An archaic rocket now rises from an octagon island. No longer disturbed, dedicated jaegers guard new kingdoms. The freakshow of the past is gone, replaced by a phoenix's orchestral ascent, pinkeyes gazing upon a finical, effortless kerygma. Mwahaha, the future is here.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: Under a harsh daytime sky, a lone journeyer faced a desolate world, its past a warning.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a desolate, ash-choked landscape under a harsh daytime sky. Jagged, ugly rock formations dominate the horizon, with petrified fossils embedded in their surfaces. An ancient, rusted iceboat is half-buried in the foreground, its broken muffler jutting out. Distant orioles circle a barely visible haven, a shimmering mirage of green. A lone teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, journeyed across the shaking ground, the ember of a dying fire in their hand, contemplating the wrath of the ultimates who could abandon such a juicy world. The harmful heckler of the wind whips around them, lamping the paradigm of their solitude.

scenes.sentence: Determined, they worked to unravel a paradox, a shadowy figure watching from afar.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, determinedly working on a makeshift faraday cage, its thatch roof dripping with condensation. Around them, iffy, bioluminescent frogs glow faintly in the shadows. The ground is riddled with strange geology, creating a mindfuck of patterns. They muse over ancient hadiths found in a dilapidated store, seeking a vaccine against the destruction that has left everything drippy and uncertain. A cassock-clad figure, their face still unmaskable, observes from a distant gangway, a paradox of chatoyant shadows and flickering light, with tiny hamsters scurrying at their feet.

scenes.sentence: With reluctant focus, they faced ancient keypads, a flashback of knowledge guiding their hand.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up, almost an extreme close-up, on the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls. Their fingers are poised over archaic keypads, glowing with faint, intricate symbols. Their face, illuminated by the screen's light, shows a reluctant focus. A flashback of ancient educations flickers in their eyes. An icepick lies nearby, its tip reflecting the light from a stack of burnt toast. They are on a precarious decking, high in a penthouse, surrounded by blenders that are halving unknown substances, remembering the kidders who thrived on pigwash. A sense of inswathe witchcraft permeates the air, forever tied to their objective: avoiding the porridge fate.

scenes.sentence: From an octagonal island, a rocket launched, ushering in an effortless, vibrant new era.
scenes.prompt: Wide overhead shot of a vibrant, regenerated island, shaped like an octagon, now a haven of new life. A rocket, sleek and finical, makes a slow, effortless liftoff from the center, leaving a trail of pinkeyes smoke. The teenager's cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is seen on a pedestal as a monument. The night sky is filled with an orchestral display of stars. Archaic, towering jaegers patrol the perimeter of new kingdoms. The grotesque freakshow of the past is gone, replaced by a phoenix rising from the ashes. Inconnus creatures stir nightly in the undergrowth, but the disturbed peace is held firm by a dedicated spirit and the kerygma of a renewed world. Mwahaha, the future is now.
